an6.55:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
an6.55:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā soṇo rājagahe viharati sītavanasmiṃ.
an6.55:1.4: atha kho āyasmato soṇassa rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
an6.55:1.5: “ye kho keci bhagavato sāvakā āraddhaviriyā viharanti, ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataro.
an6.55:1.6: atha ca pana me na anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati. saṃvijjanti kho pana me kule bhogā. sakkā bhoge ca bhuñjituṃ puññāni ca kātuṃ.
an6.55:1.7: yannūnāhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjeyyaṃ, puññāni ca kareyyanti.
an6.55:2.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato soṇassa cetasā ceto parivitakkamaññāya seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, eva mevaṃ gijjhakūṭe pabbate antarahito sītavane āyasmato soṇassa pamukhe pāturahosi.
an6.55:2.3: āyasmāpi kho soṇo bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an6.55:2.4: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ soṇaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
an6.55:3.1: nanu te soṇa, rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
an6.55:3.2: “ye kho keci bhagavato sāvakā āraddhaviriyā viharanti, ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataro,
an6.55:3.3: atha ca pana me na anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati. saṃvijjanti kho pana me kule bhogā. sakkā bhoge ca bhuñjituṃ puññāni ca kātuṃ.
an6.55:3.4: yannūnāhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjeyyaṃ, puññāni ca kareyyanti.”
an6.55:4.2: kusalo tvaṃ pubbe agārikabhūto vīṇāya tantissareti.
an6.55:4.4: taṃ kiṃ maññesi soṇa yadā te vīṇāya tantiyo accāyatā honti, api nu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti, kammaññā vāti.
an6.55:5.1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi soṇa yadā te vīṇāya tantiyo atisithilā honti, api nu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vāti
an6.55:6.1: yadā pana te soṇa vīṇāya tantiyo na accāyatā honti na atisithilā, same guṇe patiṭṭhitā, api nu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vāti.
an6.55:7.1: kho soṇa accāraddhaṃ viriyaṃ uddhaccāya saṃvattati. atilīnaṃ viriyaṃ kosajjāya saṃvattati.
an6.55:7.2: tasmātiha tvaṃ soṇa, viriyasamataṃ adhiṭṭhaha, indriyānaṃ ca samataṃ paṭivijjha, tattha ca nimittaṃ gaṇhāhīti.
an6.55:7.4: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ soṇaṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya. pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evameva kho sītavane antarahito gijjhakūṭe pabbate pāturahosi.
an6.55:8.1: atha kho āyasmā soṇo aparena samayena viriyasamataṃ adhiṭṭhāsi indriyānañca samataṃ paṭivijjhi. tattha ca nimittaṃ aggahesi.
an6.55:8.2: atha kho āyasmā soṇo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
an6.55:8.3: “khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā”ti abbhaññāsi.
an6.55:8.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā soṇo arahataṃ ahosi.
an6.55:9.1: atha kho āyasmato soṇassa arahattappattassa etadahosi:
an6.55:9.2: “yannūnāhaṃ yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkameyyaṃ, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato santike aññaṃ vyākareyyanti”.
an6.55:9.3: atha kho āyasmā soṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅgamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādevā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an6.55:10.1: yo so bhante bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññāvimutto, so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti:
an6.55:10.2: nekkhammādhimutto hoti. pavivekādhimutto hoti. abyāpajjhādhimutto hoti. taṇhakkhayādhimutto hoti. upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti. asammohādhimutto hoti. (1)
an6.55:11.1: siyā kho pana bhante, idhekaccassa āyasmato evamassa:
an6.55:11.3: na kho panetaṃ bhante evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
an6.55:11.4: khīṇāsavo bhante bhikkhū vusitavā. katakaraṇīyo, karaṇīyaṃ attano asamanupassanto katassavā paticayaṃ, khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā nekkhammādhimutto hoti. khayā dosassa vītadosattā nekkhammādhimutto hoti, khayā mohassa vītamohattā nekkhammādhimutto hoti. (2)
an6.55:12.1: siyā kho pana bhante, idhekaccassa āyasmato evamassa:
an6.55:12.3: na kho panetaṃ bhante. evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
an6.55:12.4: khīṇāsavo bhante, bhikkhu vusitavā katakaraṇīyo, karaṇīyaṃ attano asamanupassanto katassa vā paticayaṃ, khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā pavivekādhimutto hoti, khayā dosassa vītadosattā pavivekādhimutto hoti, khayā mohassa vītamohattā pavivekādhimutto hoti. (3)
an6.55:13.1: siyā kho pana bhante, idhekaccassa āyasmato. evamassa:
an6.55:13.2: sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ nūna ayamāyasmā sārato paccāgacchanto abyāpajjhādhimutto hoti.
an6.55:13.3: na kho panetaṃ bhante, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
an6.55:13.4: khīṇāsavo bhante, bhikkhu vusitavā katakaraṇīyo, karaṇīyaṃ attano asamanupassanto katassa vā paticayaṃ, khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā abyāpajjhādhimutto hoti, khayā dosassa vītadosattā, abyāpajjhādhimutto hoti. …pe… (4)
an6.55:14.1: khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā taṇhakkhayādhimutto hoti, khayā dosassa vītadosattā taṇhakkhayādhimutto hoti, khayā mohassa vītamohattā taṇhakkhayādhimutto hoti. …pe… (5)
an6.55:15.1: khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti, khayā dosassa vītadosattā upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti, khayā mohassa vītamohattā upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti. …pe… (6)
an6.55:16.1: khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā asammohādhimutto hoti, khayā dosassa vītadosattā asammohādhimutto hoti, khayā mohassa vītamohattā asammohādhimutto hoti.
an6.55:17.1: evaṃ sammāvimuttacittassa, bhante, bhikkhuno bhusā cepi cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā cakkhussa āpāthamāgacchanti, nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti,
an6.55:17.2: amissīkatamevassa cittaṃ hoti, ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ. vayañcassānupassati.
an6.55:17.8: amissīkatamevassa cittaṃ hoti, ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ, vayañcassānupassati.
an6.55:17.9: seyyathāpi bhante selo pabbato acchiddo asusiro ekaghano.
an6.55:17.10: atha puratthimāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi neva taṃ saṅkampeyya, na sampakampeyya, na sampavedheyya, atha pacchimāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi …pe…
an6.55:17.11: atha uttarāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi …pe…
an6.55:17.12: atha dakkhiṇāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi neva taṃ saṅkampeyya, na sampakampeyya, na sampavedheyya.
an6.55:17.13: evameva kho bhante, evaṃ sammāvimuttacittassa bhikkhuno bhusā cepi cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā cakkhussa āpāthamāgacchanti, nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti.
an6.55:17.14: amissīkatamevassa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ, vayaṃ cassānupassati.
an6.55:17.19: manoviññeyyā dhammā manassa āpāthamāgacchanti, nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti,
an6.55:17.20: amissīkatamevassa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ, vayaṃ cassānupassatī’ti.
